subject: EdgeWave SKU entitlement mapping + marketplace launch runbook
messages:
From: Sara Thompson <sara@edgewave.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@edgewave.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SKU mapping + entitlement ask for marketplace listing

Hi Grace / Ben —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. EdgeWave is moving to GA for our observability bundle in mid-August and we want to make sure the marketplace packaging and entitlement model lines up with Redwood’s sell-with / private-offer flows. High-level asks: 

- Confirm which SKU types Redwood needs for a mixed private-offer + public listing (metered hourly vs bundled annual).
- Guidance on entitlements fallback when a reseller sells via private offers (seller vs buyer-initiated chargeback).
- A short runbook we can include in our partner portal with steps for listing, entitlement mapping, and who to cc for billing disputes.

Attached is our current SKU sheet (EdgeWave_SKU_Map_Q3.xlsx) and a very rough runbook draft. Can you point us to the right owners on your side and any specific constraints for GCP/Azure private offers?

We'd like to lock an operational runbook by the week of July 12 so our GTM and engineering teams can coordinate.

Appreciate it — happy to hop in a short sync if helpful.

Best,
Sara Thompson
Head of Partnerships
EdgeWave Solutions
[attachment: EdgeWave_SKU_Map_Q3.xlsx (xlsx)]
[attachment: edgewave-launch-runbook-draft.md (md)]

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara@edgewave.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU mapping + entitlement ask for marketplace listing

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments.

Quick responses and proposed owners below: 

- SKU types: Redwood supports both metered hourly and bundled annual SKUs. For a hybrid listing (public catalog + private offers) we recommend: one public listing SKU (hourly) + one private-offer SKU (annual bundle) that maps to the same entitlement group. This prevents duplicate entitlements in the same account and simplifies billing reconciliation.

- Entitlement fallback: When a private offer is accepted, the entitlement should route to the purchaser's org-id. If a reseller is transacting on behalf of a customer, we need a partner-id header in the purchase call so charges and entitlements can be reconciled to the reseller. Billing disputes are routed to marketplace-billing@redwood.com — Ben, can you confirm we can accept partner-id headers for AWS/Azure offers?

- Runbook: we'll draft a short operational runbook that covers 1) SKU naming conventions, 2) purchase flow examples (public vs private offers), 3) required metadata (partner-id, offer-id), and 4) escalation path for entitlements/billing. Olga — can you review the technical mapping and scope any API gaps for private-offer entitlement propagation? Vivek — I'll need you to confirm partner-governance checklist and whether we can surface a co-sell tag for deal attribution.

We can iterate on the attached draft and I’ll share a Redwood-styled runbook by EOD July 6 for your review. If that timeline is tight, tell me your blockers and we'll adjust.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Subject: Re: SKU mapping + entitlement ask for marketplace listing

Grace / Sara —

I reviewed EdgeWave_SKU_Map_Q3.xlsx and the draft runbook. A few technical notes we should bake into the runbook (keeps things operationally deterministic):

1) Entitlement group key: use a stable 'product_code' that maps to Redwood entitlement groups. We recommend product_code = EW_OBS_BUNDLE_v1 (example). Avoid SKU-level entitlements for features inside the bundle — keep entitlements at bundle granularity to simplify KV cache and license checks.

2) Private-offer metadata: for AWS Managed Private Offers and Azure Private Offers we can accept a custom header `x-partner-id` during the activation webhook. That header flows into our billing pipeline if present. Edge case: if a reseller uses marketplace-managed billing, the partner-id will be null; we then match on invoice references and fallback to the 'seller_email' field. Add both matching methods to the runbook.

3) Metering vs bundle: if you plan metered add-ons (e.g., advanced retention), expose a separate SKU with `metering=true`. We'll provide sample payloads for both a bundled annual activation and a metered hourly activation.

4) Docs & test harness: I've attached a small sample payload for the activation webhook and a Postman collection link (in the Drive folder). Please include a QA window during your private-offer acceptance test where we validate entitlement creation and invoice mapping.

I'll add the sample payload and an API checklist to the runbook before EOD. Ben — can you confirm the billing contact and whether we need any legal/TOU flags for Azure's reseller flow?

- Olga
Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: activation-sample.json (json)]

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@edgewave.com>

Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU mapping + entitlement ask for marketplace listing

Grace / Olga / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the helpful notes. We agree with the bundle-level entitlement approach — makes QA and customer support much simpler. Next steps from our side: 

- We'll update the SKU sheet to include product_code (using your suggested EW_OBS_BUNDLE_v1) and mark separate add-ons as metered SKUs. Updated file will be in the Drive link by EOD Wednesday.
- We'll schedule a 30-min entitlements QA on July 14 (UTC) to exercise private-offer activation flows against Redwood staging. Sara will share the invite once she checks internal calendars.
- I'll also route a copy of the draft runbook to our GTM and billing teams and flag any legal/TOU items.

A couple of asks for Redwood ahead of the QA:
1) A short checklist of fields you expect in the activation webhook (we saw the sample payload from Olga but a one-page checklist will help our SREs).
2) Confirmation of an internal billing contact for quick triage during staging (billing@redwood.com or marketplace-billing@redwood.com?).

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to the QA window.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Director, Cloud Partnerships
EdgeWave Solutions
